facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber said the Electronic Travel Authorisation has declined over 30,000 tourist-visa applications using machine learning to verify the authenticity of documents such as passports.

ZAF.note: The ETA is general visa administration, not a sector system the study names.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
The ETA's face match is to a passport photo for visa applicants, not an authentication service for people to prove identity.
No link between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
Nothing is stated on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Minister Schreiber said Home Affairs is working to build an Intelligent Population Register to anchor a new Digital ID system that will record biometrics for every person in South Africa.
Minister Schreiber said Home Affairs is working to build an Intelligent Population Register to anchor a new Digital ID system.
